purpose: Prove cross-video safety without requiring modeled-card coverage or CHAIN_OK on every holdout.

registration_rule.rule: Register the holdout identity before gameplay analysis or tuning. Computing file metadata or SHA-256 is allowed before registration; inspecting gameplay content is not.

structural_no_ng: no false HP transient becomes a final review point
presentation does not roll back to a stale or duplicate authority path
review playback seeks to the intended authority window
no_wrong_coach: no speculative completion of unknown or unresolved evidence
acceptance_policy.hold_policy: If the pipeline HOLDs, the HOLD class and reason must be supported by the observed authority and surfaced correctly.
acceptance_policy.chain_ok_policy: If one or more CHAIN_OK windows occur, perform Human Review on those windows in addition to the structural and HOLD checks.

holdouts.registration_scope: Identity and container metadata only; gameplay content was not inspected before registration.
